preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the binary tree is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
Each element in the array arr[] represents the parent of the corresponding node, and the parent can be between 0 and 10^5, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: There is exactly one node with arr[i] = -1, which is the root of the binary tree.
preconditions.description: The root node is identified by its parent being -1.

postconditions.description: The height of the binary tree is at least 1.
The height of the binary tree is at most N, the total number of nodes.

postconditions.expression: height == max(depth(node) for node in nodes)
postconditions.description: The height of the binary tree is the maximum depth of any node in the tree.
